M12 adopted 23.98 at n=2 deliberately, and the rebalance ruling computed its 62 percent share and the 934.47 dollar total at n=2, because retiring a TRAP does not invalidate a COST observation. The error understated the floor by 900 to 2,100 dollars and fed straight into D29's cost-grounds N decision, so it was corrected in the frozen pre-registration as a stated-reason pre-run commit under scenario 3's discipline, ruled as D30, with the freeze wording left strict and the correction exception named in the header instead. Priced floor is now 3,134.76 dollars over 156 sessions with a whole-floor bracket of 4,163 to 6,588 dollars, brillo quoted as a range with its 2.1x within-source spread.
